item.title: AZ axe Maarten Martens; Robin Van Persie faces growing pressure after derby defeat
item.description: AZ has sacked Maarten Martens from the manager position. The Belgian was relieved of his duties after a 3-1 loss to PEC Zwolle on Saturday.

item.title: Police launch fake ticket website to warn against scams
item.description: In an effort to combat ticket fraud, police have launched a mock ticket sales website offering access to in-demand concerts and sporting events, such as football games.

item.title: Video: Honey, Netherlands’ oldest dolphin, euthanized at 58
item.description: Honey, the oldest dolphin in the Netherlands and the second-oldest in Europe, died Wednesday, January 14, at the Dolfinarium Harderwijk,

item.title: Riot police intervene in Amsterdam, The Hague after Morocco loses Africa Cup of Nations
item.description: Riot police had to intervene in Amsterdam and The Hague on Sunday night due to unrest following Morocco’s loss in the Africa Cup of Nations final.

item.title: Suicide on the rise among young Dutch under 30, especially young women
item.description: The number of suicides among young people under 30 is on the rise in the Netherlands. In 2024, 212 teenagers and people in their 20s took their own lives.

item.title: Some 80% of Dutch people no longer consider U.S. a reliable partner
item.description: The vast majority of Dutch people believe that Europe can no longer count on the United States for its security.

item.title: Rich get richer: Net worth of world’s billionaires jumps 16% to €16 trillion
item.description: The combined wealth of billionaires rose to a record $18.3 trillion, or €15.75 trillion, last year.

item.title: Video: Stadskanaal home destroyed by fire, explosion; Police suspect arson
item.description: A fire, possibly preceded by an explosion, destroyed a home in Stadskanaal overnight. Surrounding homes were evacuated, and paramedics treated two people for smoke inhalation.

item.title: Many Dutch employers still don't have formal agreements around hybrid working
item.description: With around 5 million hybrid workers, people who regularly or occasionally work from home, the Netherlands has proportionally more people working from home than anywhere else in Europe.
